name: VR: Vacate the Room (Escape Room)
summary:
With it's Early Access on the 30th of June 2016, VR: Vacate the Room was the first VR Escape Room on PC.

Finally - after almost 10 years - it arrives on the Meta Quest. 

With controller and hand tracking support.

But what is it:
It is a VR Experience where you need to find clues to solve puzzles and find your way out of the Room. There are some items that can be grabbed and carried around. With some items you can interact (such as switches and numpads).

Good to know:
There is a second room with an alter
